assessment.summary: This is a review paper titled 'Omics Approaches in Understanding Insecticide Resistance in Mosquito Vectors' published in the International Journal of Molecular Sciences. It summarizes existing knowledge on omics technologies (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, and microbiomics) applied to insecticide resistance in mosquitoes. It does not report original empirical data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report original extractable genotype data
